# myst

<!-- okfreq:index:start -->
<!-- Generated by okfreq lint; edit requirement metadata instead. -->

- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-001 — Admonitions render as coloured callouts with a title](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-001.md) — When a document holds an admonition directive, the extension SHALL render a panel with the title, accent colour, badge and Markdown body of its kind, and a custom, untitled, simple, icon-less, version or Quarto form keeps its own title and decoration.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-002 — Admonitions take an accent colour and badge by kind](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-002.md) — When an admonition panel renders, the extension SHALL colour it and give it a badge according to its kind, with the badge taking the accent colour.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-003 — Admonition galleries keep one title line per panel without sideways scroll](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-003.md) — When the preview renders an admonition gallery at any theme and pane width, the extension SHALL give each admonition exactly one title line, a source line and a panel colour distinct from the page, with no horizontal overflow.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-004 — Custom admonitions show their written title and class colour](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-004.md) — When a document holds an `{admonition}` directive with a title argument, the extension SHALL show the title as written with inline Markdown rendered and colour the panel by its `:class:` kind.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-005 — Untitled admonitions take their title from a leading bold line or heading](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-005.md) — When an admonition has no title argument and its body starts with a bold line or a heading, the extension SHALL use that line as the panel title and keep the rest as body.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-006 — Admonitions nest, collapse and map as one block](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-006.md) — When an admonition directive contains another directive, the extension SHALL render the inner panel inside its parent panel, keep inner fences as literal code under a longer outer fence, collapse a dropdown under its title, and map each admonition as one block from its opening line to its closing fence.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-007 — A longer outer fence keeps inner fences as literal code](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-007.md) — When an admonition uses a longer fence than an inner `markdown` fence or inner admonition, the extension SHALL keep the inner fence as literal code in the body.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-008 — An admonition is one mapped block over its whole directive](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-008.md) — When an admonition renders, the extension SHALL map it as one block from its opening line to its closing fence.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-009 — Dropdown admonitions collapse under their title](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-009.md) — When an admonition has `:class: dropdown` or an `:open:` option, the extension SHALL render a collapsible section with the title as summary, closed unless `:open: true`.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-010 — Simple and icon-less admonitions drop their decoration](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-010.md) — When an admonition has `:class: simple` or `:icon: false`, the extension SHALL render a plain left-bar callout or hide the badge respectively.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-011 — Version admonitions show their version title](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-011.md) — When a document holds `{versionadded}`, `{versionchanged}` or `{deprecated}`, the extension SHALL render an admonition titled Added in version X:, Changed in version X: or Deprecated since version X: followed by the body.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-012 — Quarto callouts render as simple admonitions](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-012.md) — When a document holds a Quarto callout div such as `::: {.callout-tip}`, the extension SHALL render a simple admonition of that kind with the leading heading as title.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-013 — Context tags render as titled panels](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-013.md) — When a document holds a lower-case context tag alone on its line with a matching closing tag, the extension SHALL render a no-icon admonition panel titled with the literal tag around the Markdown between the tags, mapped from opening to closing line, nested pairs as nested panels, and keep an unpaired or non-context tag visible as literal text.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-014 — Nested context tags render as nested panels](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-014.md) — When context tag pairs are nested, the extension SHALL render each pair as its own panel, the inner one inside the outer, each with its own source range.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-015 — Unpaired or non-context tags stay visible as text](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-015.md) — When a tag cannot be paired or is not a context tag, the extension SHALL keep it visible as literal text with its body.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-016 — Context tags group inside containers and split raw HTML blocks](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-016.md) — When a context tag pair sits inside a block quote, list item, definition list or directive container, or forms a raw HTML block kept whole by the parser, the extension SHALL group it as a panel and parse its Markdown.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-017 — Definition lists and inline roles are typeset](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-017.md) — When a document holds a term followed by `: Definition` lines or an inline `{sub}`, `{sup}`, `{abbr}`, `{kbd}`, `{doc}`, `{download}` or `{numref}` role, the extension SHALL render a definition list, subscript, superscript, an abbreviation with its expansion as title, a keyboard key, a plain link to the written target, or an inert placeholder for the numbered reference.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-018 — Inline roles sub, sup, abbr and kbd render](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-018.md) — When a document uses the roles `{sub}`, `{sup}`, `{abbr}` or `{kbd}`, the extension SHALL render subscript, superscript, an abbreviation with its expansion as title, or a keyboard key.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-019 — Reference roles link to in-page targets](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-019.md) — When a document uses `{ref}` to a heading, figure, table, equation or `(name)=` label, the extension SHALL render an in-page link showing the target text or the given text, and for a figure or table without a caption a readable link, not an empty one.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-020 — Unresolved citations show as muted keys](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-020.md) — When a document uses `{cite}`, the extension SHALL show each key as muted `\[key\]` with the tooltip Unresolved citation: key and list no warning.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-021 — Directives needing a build show an inert placeholder with a warning](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-021.md) — When a document holds a directive the preview cannot resolve without a project build, the extension SHALL show an inert placeholder `{name} arguments` with its body and one warning Directive {name} is not available outside a full build.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-022 — The bibliography directive explains build-time resolution](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-022.md) — When a document holds a `{bibliography}` directive, the extension SHALL show a placeholder saying Bibliography resolves at build time.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-023 — Notebook output references show a note and a warning](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-023.md) — When a document holds a notebook output reference such as `#tbl:` or an unexecuted `{code-cell}` output, the extension SHALL show a note and a warning.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-024 — Maths is typeset offline by KaTeX and bad formulas stay readable](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-024.md) — When a document holds `$...$`, `$$...$$`, the `{math}` role or directive, or an align-style environment inside `$$` or `{math}`, the extension SHALL typeset it as maths with KaTeX from the extension bundle without network or inline styles, keep a formula that cannot be parsed readable, refuse active content, and scroll a long display equation inside its own box.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-025 — Maths typesets offline without inline styles](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-025.md) — When the preview typesets maths, the extension SHALL load the KaTeX stylesheet and fonts from the extension bundle, emit no inline style attribute and need no script or network request.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-026 — Unparsable formulas stay readable](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-026.md) — When KaTeX cannot parse a formula, the extension SHALL keep its raw TeX with a wavy underline and the tooltip This equation could not be rendered by KaTeX, and still render the other equations.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-027 — Maths cannot run active content](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-027.md) — When a formula uses `\\href`, `\\htmlStyle` or another trusted command, the extension SHALL refuse it with an error text and no link or style, and bound expansion and size.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-028 — Sphinx-style math delimiters are typeset](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-028.md) — When the rendered page holds `\\(x^2\\)` in a math span or `\\\[...\\\]` in a math block, the extension SHALL typeset it, leave `$...$` outside math nodes and code alone, and change nothing when typesetting twice.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-029 — Long display equations scroll inside their box](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-029.md) — When a display equation is wider than the pane, the extension SHALL scroll it sideways inside its own box and not widen the page.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-030 — Prices are not reported as missing dollarmath](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-030.md) — When a document holds dollar amounts such as `$19 base ... ($200)`, `$5 and $6` or `$100-$380`, the extension SHALL not report a missing dollarmath extension for them.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-031 — Figures render with image, caption, label, width and alignment](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-031.md) — When a document holds a `{figure}` directive with colon or backtick fences, the extension SHALL render a figure with its image, `:alt:`, caption, `:name:` as id, a validated width and a validated alignment, mapped as one block from opening line to closing fence.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-032 — Figure images outside the document folder load](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-032.md) — When a figure image path points to a sibling folder such as `../external-img/depot-graph.svg`, the extension SHALL load it and keep its landmark in the frame.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-033 — Figure width values are validated](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-033.md) — When a `{figure}` or `{image}` has `:width:`, the extension SHALL keep a number or a number with px, %, em or rem as data-okf-width and drop any other value.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-034 — The page applies figure widths through the CSSOM](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-034.md) — When a figure or image has a requested width, the extension SHALL apply it from the page without inline styles, including after every in-place content update.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-035 — Figure alignment sets align classes and float](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-035.md) — When a `{figure}` or `{image}` has `:align:` left, center or right, the extension SHALL give the figure and image an align class, floating left and right beside the text.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-036 — Labels show an anchor icon on the next block](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-036.md) — When a document holds a `(name)=` label, the extension SHALL show a faint anchor icon with the tooltip Anchor: name as the first child of the next paragraph or heading without moving the text, make it a link target without duplicating an existing id, and keep the icon out of the mapped blocks and the Tab order with the absolute source line of its label.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-037 — The anchor icon is not a mapped block and carries its source line](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-037.md) — When an anchor icon renders, the extension SHALL leave it out of the mapped blocks and Tab order and give it data-okf-label-line with the absolute source line of its label.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-038 — The anchor icon opens a rename field that sends valid names](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-038.md) — When a reader clicks the anchor icon of a label in edit mode, the extension SHALL open a Rename label popover with a prefilled, selected, focused Label name field before block click handling, send a rename only for a changed valid name and show the answer of the host in the field.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-039 — Enter sends the label rename and an unchanged name sends nothing](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-039.md) — When the Label name field is submitted with Enter, the extension SHALL send one rename with the label line, and close without sending when the name is unchanged.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-040 — Escape or an outside press closes the rename field](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-040.md) — When the rename field is open, the extension SHALL close it on Escape or on a pointer press outside the popover and the icon.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-041 — Invalid label names are not sent](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-041.md) — When the new label name is empty, longer than 100 characters, starts with a non letter or digit, or uses characters other than letters, digits and _ . : -, the extension SHALL not send it and show Use letters, digits and _ . : - only, starting with a letter or digit (100 characters at most).
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-042 — The host refuses a rename in an untrusted or read-only preview](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-042.md) — When a rename arrives for an untrusted or read-only preview, the extension SHALL change nothing and answer Renaming needs a trusted workspace.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-043 — The host refuses a rename while an edit is open](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-043.md) — When a rename arrives while a block edit is open, the extension SHALL change nothing and answer Save or cancel the open Markdown edit before renaming a label.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-044 — The host refuses a rename for an out-of-date preview](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-044.md) — When a rename is for a document revision the host has moved past, the extension SHALL change nothing and answer The preview is out of date. Try again once it has refreshed.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-045 — The host renames only the label text in one undo step](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-045.md) — When the host receives a label rename, the extension SHALL change only the `(old)=` text of the stated line as one undo step of the source editor, keeping surrounding whitespace and CRLF endings, and when that line is no longer exactly `(old)=` change nothing and answer The label is no longer on that line. Refresh the preview, without searching other lines.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-046 — A valid rename edits only the label text as one undo step](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-046.md) — When a valid rename is accepted, the extension SHALL change only the `(old)=` text of that line as one undo step of the source editor, keeping surrounding whitespace and CRLF endings.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-047 — A successful rename reports the remaining uses](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-047.md) — When a rename succeeds, the extension SHALL show Renamed. N use(s) of old remain in this document, counting `{ref}` forms only, or Renamed. No use of the old name remains.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-048 — The rename field shows progress and refusals](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-048.md) — When the host works on a rename, the extension SHALL disable the field with Renaming..., match the answer by edit id and leave it editable after a refusal showing its reason.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-049 — The rename field times out after 6 seconds](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-049.md) — When the host does not answer a rename within 6 s, the extension SHALL enable the field again with The editor did not answer. Try again.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-050 — Rename is blocked while an editor is open in the page](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-050.md) — When a block editor or the properties editor is open, the extension SHALL open the rename field disabled with Save or cancel the open edit before renaming a label and post nothing.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-051 — The label rename message is validated and answered](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-051.md) — When the page posts previewLabelRename, the extension SHALL accept it only with a source line, two valid label names and the current render, and answer previewLabelRenameResult with the same edit id.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-052 — The MyST gallery renders without sideways scroll](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-052.md) — When the MyST gallery document renders in dark and light themes at 900 px, the extension SHALL show a reference link, a closed dropdown, a definition list, sub and superscript, a kbd key, an abbreviation, a footnote and typeset inline math with no horizontal overflow.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-053 — Grids lay out cards in responsive columns](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-053.md) — When a document holds a `{grid}` with `{grid-item-card}` items, the extension SHALL lay out its items in the columns of its argument, such as `1 1 2 2`, for the extra-small, small, medium and large panes, chosen by the pane width, and show each card with its title, header, body, footer and link.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-054 — Grid columns follow the pane width](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-054.md) — When the preview pane width changes, the extension SHALL pick grid columns by container width (480, 640, 800 px), not the window width.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-055 — Grid item cards show title, header, body, footer and link](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-055.md) — When a `{grid-item-card}` is rendered, the extension SHALL show its title, an optional header before `^^^`, body and footer after `+++`, and make the title one link when `:link:` is given.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-056 — Grids nest and keep absolute source lines](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-056.md) — When grids use backtick, tilde or colon fences and nest up to 8 levels, the extension SHALL keep absolute source lines for everything inside, blank lines included.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-057 — Toctree lists linked documents and marks missing ones](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-057.md) — When a document holds a `{toctree}`, the extension SHALL list its documents as links that open in the preview, labelled by the given title, else the first level-1 heading, else the file name, expand glob entries in sorted order and show a document that cannot be found as warned text without a link.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-058 — Toctree caption and hidden options](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-058.md) — When a toctree has `:caption:` or `:hidden:`, the extension SHALL show the caption as a level-2 heading above the list or show nothing.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-059 — Toctree glob entries list matching documents sorted](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-059.md) — When a toctree has `:glob:` entries with wildcards, the extension SHALL list the matching documents in sorted order.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-060 — Toctree reversed option flips the order](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-060.md) — When a toctree has `:reversed:`, the extension SHALL flip the entry order.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-061 — Toctree shows at most 500 entries](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-061.md) — When a toctree holds more than 500 entries, the extension SHALL show at most 500.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-062 — Missing toctree documents show as warned text](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-062.md) — When a toctree entry's document cannot be found, the extension SHALL show its text without a link in a warning style with the tooltip Document not found: name and add no warning to the status region or Problems view.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-063 — Table directives render as ordinary tables](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-063.md) — When a document holds a `{list-table}`, `{csv-table}` or `{table}` directive, the extension SHALL render it as an ordinary table with the table styles, with its caption, header rows, widths and alignment as the directive options give them, and offer the table palette action.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-064 — Invalid list-table widths are ignored](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-064.md) — When `:widths:` is `auto`, `grid`, non numeric or does not match the column count, the extension SHALL ignore it and make no column group.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-065 — The table directive renders a table with caption, id and alignment](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-065.md) — When a document holds a `{table}` directive, the extension SHALL render a table with its caption, its `:label:` as id and its `:align:`, keeping GFM column alignment on every cell.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-066 — The governing conf.py is found and read as text](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-066.md) — When a document is checked, the extension SHALL take its enabled MyST extensions from the governing `conf.py`, found as the nearest one in the document's folder or any folder up to the workspace root (never one above the root, and for a document outside the workspace only its own folder) or else as the single conf.py of a common Sphinx folder at the root, read as text and never run, and report nothing when no certain list results.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-067 — A single conf-folder candidate governs when no ancestor conf exists](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-067.md) — When no conf.py is found above a document, the extension SHALL use the single conf.py among docs/, doc/, sphinx/, source/ and docs/source/ at the workspace root, and none when two or more exist.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-068 — conf.py is read as text and the check needs a MyST parser](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-068.md) — When the extension reads a conf.py, the extension SHALL never run it and check only when `extensions` contains myst_parser or myst_nb, reporting nothing when no conf, no parser or an uncertain list.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-069 — The conf.py reader understands list literal forms](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-069.md) — When a conf.py writes `extensions` or `myst_enable_extensions` as list or tuple literals, the extension SHALL read their elements whatever the quoting, prefix, comment, continuation or line ending.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-070 — Uncertain conf.py lists suppress all warnings](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-070.md) — When a list in conf.py uses a computed value, f-string, bytes or other prefixed string or `-=`, the extension SHALL treat the result as uncertain and show no warnings.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-071 — conf.py lookups are cached and invalidated](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-071.md) — When the extension looks up a conf.py, the extension SHALL trust a folder's result and a file's parse for 2 s, re-check by modification time and size afterwards, and drop all caches when any conf.py is created, changed or deleted.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-072 — MyST syntax of a disabled extension is reported with its line](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-072.md) — When a document uses syntax of a MyST extension that the governing conf.py does not enable, the extension SHALL list one `myst-extension` warning per extension, at the first use of that syntax and with the line of the syntax itself, at most 10 per render, and leave the rendering unchanged.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-073 — At most 10 extension warnings are kept](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-073.md) — When more than 10 extension warnings are detected, the extension SHALL keep at most 10.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-074 — Detection ignores code, comments, roles and look-alikes](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-074.md) — When syntax appears in fenced or indented code, inline code, comments or roles, or looks like but is not an extension syntax, the extension SHALL report nothing.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-075 — Warnings carry the line of the syntax](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-075.md) — When a warning is reported, the extension SHALL give the line of the syntax itself, including inside long paragraphs, after frontmatter and with CRLF or CR breaks.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-076 — Included files are not checked against conf.py](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-076.md) — When a document brings in a file with `{include}`, the extension SHALL not check the included text against conf.py.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-077 — Extension warnings use the fixed wording and status list](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-077.md) — When an extension is missing, the extension SHALL list one warning in the status area as file:line: message, severity warning and code myst-extension, reading, with SYNTAX the used syntax and EXTENSION the missing extension: `SYNTAX` is used but this needs the MyST extension `EXTENSION`, which is not enabled in your conf.py. Add "EXTENSION" to `myst_enable_extensions`. Rendering stays unchanged.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-078 — Extension warnings appear in the Problems view and follow conf.py](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-078.md) — When a live preview shows a document with extension warnings in a trusted workspace, the extension SHALL publish them to the Problems view as whole-line warnings from Markdown OKF-Schema Studio with code myst-extension, the line clamped to the document length, replace or remove them when the document re-renders, its preview closes or its document changes, and re-render the open previews a created, edited or deleted conf.py governs.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-079 — Problems entries are replaced and removed](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-079.md) — When a document re-renders, its preview closes or its document changes, the extension SHALL replace or remove its Problems entries.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-080 — conf.py changes update the previews they govern](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-080.md) — When a conf.py is created, edited or deleted, the extension SHALL re-render exactly the open previews it governs without reopening them, deferred while a block edit is open.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-081 — A closable banner announces conf.py warnings](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-081.md) — When a render succeeds with conf.py warnings, the extension SHALL show a one-line banner N MyST syntax warning(s) from conf.py with a warning icon, an Open Problems button and a Close the warning button, as a polite status after the status region in Tab order, that takes no layout room and stays closed for that document until the set of warning texts changes.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-082 — The banner takes no layout room](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-082.md) — When the banner shows, the extension SHALL place it in the 40 px gap left of the floating toolbar without covering it, move no content or scroll anchor, scroll it away with the page top, keep one line with ellipsis, stay readable in every theme and add no sideways scroll.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-083 — Open Problems opens the Problems view](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-083.md) — When the reader activates Open Problems on the banner, the extension SHALL open the host's Problems view, also for read-only and untrusted previews.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-084 — Closing the banner dismisses it for that document](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-084.md) — When the reader closes the banner, the extension SHALL remove it at once without moving anything, send the warning set key and remember it per document until VS Code restarts, handing it back on reload.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-085 — The banner returns when the warning set changes](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-085.md) — When the set of warning texts changes after a dismissal, the extension SHALL show the banner again, but not when only line numbers or order change.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-086 — In Restricted Mode the banner lists warnings in its tooltip](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-086.md) — When the workspace is untrusted, the extension SHALL not publish warnings to the Problems view and show the banner without Open Problems, listing the warnings in its tooltip, with the close button kept.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-087 — Each admonition kind renders under its own directive name](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-087.md) — When a document holds an admonition directive, the extension SHALL render it with the title, styles and palette actions of its own directive name.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-088 — The csv-table directive renders a table](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-088.md) — When a document holds a `{csv-table}` directive, the extension SHALL render a table with its caption and `:align:`, using `:header:` rows and keeping quoted multi-line cells whole.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-089 — The conf.py reader applies list mutations in order](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-089.md) — When a conf.py changes `extensions` or `myst_enable_extensions` with `=`, `+=`, `.append`, `.extend` or list addition, the extension SHALL apply the changes in written order.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-090 — The rename field closes itself after 5 seconds](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-090.md) — When a rename succeeds, the extension SHALL close the rename field 5 s after the success message.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-091 — The figure directive renders with its own styles and actions](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-091.md) — When a document holds a `{figure}` directive, the extension SHALL render it with the figure styles and offer the figure palette action.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-092 — The table directive family renders with its own styles and actions](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-092.md) — When a document holds a `{table}`, `{list-table}` or `{csv-table}` directive, the extension SHALL render it with the table styles and offer the table palette action.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-093 — A directive name registered twice is refused](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-093.md) — When two directive families declare the same directive name, the extension SHALL refuse the second registration with an error naming the duplicate.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-094 — A label starting with underscore, dot or hyphen cannot be renamed](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-094.md) — When the writer clicks the anchor icon of a label whose name starts with an underscore, a dot or a hyphen in edit mode, the extension SHALL open no rename field.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-095 — Doc and download roles render as plain links](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-095.md) — When a document uses the doc or download role, the extension SHALL render it as a plain link to the written target.
